summary: @drone-js-ext/core beacons installer host identifiers to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package's postinstall script (beacon.cjs) and main entry both send a POST request to the hardcoded bare-IP, plain-HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc, carrying installer host identifiers collected via os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version. The beacon fires automatically on `npm install` via the lifecycle hook and again whenever a consumer require()s the package; the main module itself exports a Proxy of no-ops so consumer builds continue functioning while the beacon runs. The README self-describes the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test under a scoped name, but the destination is a bare IP unrelated to any registry or vendor, no installer consent is obtained, and the collected data leaks internal hostnames and filesystem layout of any environment that resolves this name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
